name: auditing-signals
title_zh: 先看分布再谈相关的数据审计员
tagline_zh: 建模前先跑一遍诚实体检：分布打头、重尾处理、样本量门槛。流行说法到底成不成立？
tagline_en: Pre-modeling honesty check: distributions first, heavy-tail handling, sample-size floors. Popular belief vs data?
desc_en: Runs an honest EDA and signal audit — distributions first, heavy-tail handling, verdict-style mini-tests (CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE), sample-size floors. Use before modeling, when testing whether a popular belief shows up in data, or when a correlation looks too good.
why_zh: 不画饼，只下判决。每个信号都过分布关和样本量门槛，用 CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED…
why_en: No storytelling, just verdicts. Every signal clears distribution and sample-size gates, ending in.
limit_zh: 只审单变量分布与双变量相关信号，不做因果推断、不跑回归、不处理时间序列。样本量低于门槛时它直接拒判，不会给你凑合结论。
limit_en: Only audits univariate distributions and bivariate correlations. No causal claims, no regression, no time series. Below sample floor it refuses to.
title_en: An EDA auditor that checks distributions before correlations
